PrivacyPolicyText.description: Review how Qwen Image Editor protects your uploaded images, user credentials, and personal information under GDPR and CCPA. We never sell your data or train AI models on your private photos.
PrivacyPolicyText.detailText:
# Privacy Policy — Qwen Image Editor

**Last Updated:** October 5, 2026

**Qwen Image Editor** ("we", "us", or "our"), accessible at [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com) ("Service"), is dedicated to protecting your personal information and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy details how we collect, process, store, and safeguard your data, and outlines your legal privacy rights under GDPR, CCPA, and applicable global privacy laws.

---

### 1. Data Controller
The data controller responsible for personal information processed under this Service is:
- **Service Name:** Qwen Image Editor
- **Website:** [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com)
- **Privacy Contact Email:** `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Support Email:** `support@qwenimage-editor.com`

---

### 2. Information We Collect
We collect only the minimum necessary information required to deliver our AI image editing services:

#### 2.1 Information You Provide Directly
- **Account Data:** Email address, user display name, and avatar obtained via federated OAuth authentication (e.g., Google Sign-In).
- **Uploaded Content:** Source images and textual editing prompts submitted for AI transformation.
- **Communications:** Feedback, support tickets, and correspondence sent to our team.

#### 2.2 Information Collected Automatically
- **Technical & Device Data:** IP address, browser type and version, device operating system, language preferences, and referral source.
- **Usage & Performance Logs:** Timestamps of image generations, inference latency, error diagnostics, and feature interactions.

#### 2.3 Payment Information
- We do **NOT** collect or store credit card numbers, CVVs, or bank account details. All payment processing is conducted securely by our Merchant of Record, **Waffo Pancake** (see Section 5).

---

### 3. How We Use Your Information
We process your data for the following lawful purposes:
- **Providing the Service:** Executing requested AI image modifications and displaying your personal creation history.
- **Account & Security:** Authenticating user identity, managing credit balances, and preventing fraudulent activity.
- **Customer Support:** Responding to inquiries, troubleshooting technical issues, and processing refund requests.
- **Legal Compliance:** Complying with statutory accounting, tax, and regulatory obligations.

---

### 4. Image Privacy & AI Model Training
- **Strict No-Training Guarantee:** **We do NOT sell your uploaded images or personal data, and we do NOT use your private images, prompts, or generated outputs to train foundational AI models.**
- **Ephemeral Processing:** Uploaded images and generated variations are temporarily stored in secure cloud object storage (Cloudflare R2) solely to allow you to download, inspect, and reuse your creations.

---

### 5. Third-Party Service Providers & Payment Processing
We partner with trusted third-party providers who operate under strict data protection and confidentiality agreements:
- **Merchant of Record & Payments (Waffo Pancake):** All payment processing is handled by **Waffo Pancake** (Waffo.com Limited). Waffo Pancake operates under PCI-DSS Level 1 certification. Card details never touch our servers.
- **AI Inference:** Computational processing via high-security API endpoints (Alibaba Cloud Bailian / DashScope).
- **Cloud Infrastructure & Storage:** Cloudflare R2 and Supabase for encrypted data hosting and secure asset delivery.

---

### 6. Data Security & Incident Response
- **Encryption:** All communications are encrypted in transit using industry-standard TLS 1.3 / HTTPS. Media assets and database entries are encrypted at rest with AES-256.
- **Access Controls:** Strict least-privilege role-based access controls limit data accessibility to authorized personnel only.
- **Breach Notification:** In the improbable event of a data security incident affecting user rights, we commit to notifying affected users and relevant supervisory authorities within 72 hours of verification.

---

### 7. Data Retention & Deletion
- **Account Information:** Maintained as long as your account remains active. If you request account closure, personal data is permanently deleted within 90 days.
- **Generated Images:** Image assets remain accessible in your private gallery until you delete them or close your account.
- **Billing Records:** Transaction reference metadata is retained for standard statutory tax and financial audit durations (typically up to 5–7 years as required by law).

---

### 8. Your Legal Data Rights
Depending on your jurisdiction (such as the European Economic Area under GDPR or California under CCPA), you hold the following rights:
- **Right to Access:** Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
- **Right to Rectification:** Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
- **Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"):** Request deletion of your personal data.
- **Right to Restrict or Object:** Limit or object to certain forms of data processing.
- **Right to Data Portability:** Receive your data in a structured, commonly used machine-readable format.
- **No Sale of Personal Data:** We affirm that we do not sell personal data to data brokers or third parties.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com`. We will respond to verified requests within 30 days.

---

### 9. Age Restriction & Child Safety
Our Service is strictly designed for and directed to individuals aged **18 and older**. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors. If you believe a minor has provided information to us, please contact `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com` immediately for prompt investigation and deletion.

---

### 10. Policy Updates
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any material modifications will be announced via website notice or email before taking effect, and the "Last Updated" date at the top will be updated accordingly.

---

### 11. Contact Us
For questions, privacy inquiries, or data requests:
- **Privacy Contact:** `privacy@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Support Contact:** `support@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Merchant of Record:** Waffo Pancake (Waffo.com Limited)
- **Website:** [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com)

TermsOfServiceText.detailText:
# Terms of Service — Qwen Image Editor

**Last Updated:** October 5, 2026

Welcome to **Qwen Image Editor** ("Qwen Image Editor", "we", "us", or "our"), accessible at [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com) ("Service"). These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of our AI-powered image editing platform.

By creating an account, purchasing credit packages, or subscribing to our plans, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).

---

### 1. Acceptance of Terms & Eligibility
By accessing or using our Service, you confirm that:
1. You are at least **18 years of age** or have reached the legal age of majority in your jurisdiction.
2. You have the full legal capacity to enter into these binding Terms.
3. You agree to comply with all applicable local, national, and international laws.

---

### 2. Service Description
- **2.1 Digital SaaS Platform:** Qwen Image Editor is an online Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application providing AI-driven photo editing, inpainting, prompt-guided visual modifications, and creative image generation utilizing advanced Qwen-Image foundation models.
- **2.2 Instant Digital Delivery:** The Service consists of digital intangible goods and computational inference capacity. Access to subscription tiers and purchased credits is activated immediately upon successful payment confirmation.
- **2.3 Third-Party AI Infrastructure:** Our Service utilizes enterprise cloud computational infrastructure and third-party AI APIs (including Alibaba Cloud Bailian / DashScope Qwen-Image models). Temporary disruptions due to upstream maintenance will be communicated promptly.

---

### 3. Account Registration & Security
You are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials and for all actions performed through your account. If you become aware of unauthorized access, notify us immediately at `security@qwenimage-editor.com` or `support@qwenimage-editor.com`.

---

### 4. Plans & Credit System (Hybrid Model)
We offer a hybrid billing model combining recurring subscription plans and one-time credit packages:
- **Starter Pack ($4.99 one-time):** Grants 100 non-expiring generation credits.
- **Pro Monthly ($19.90/month):** Grants 500 generation credits per monthly cycle with priority GPU inference.
- **Pro Yearly ($118.80/year):** Equivalent to $9.90/month (billed annually), grants 500 generation credits refreshed every month.

Current pricing and feature inclusions are displayed on our [Pricing Page](/pricing).

---

### 5. Billing, Payment & Merchant of Record
- **5.1 Merchant of Record (Waffo Pancake):** All payments, transaction processing, and recurring subscription billings are managed and processed by our authorized Merchant of Record, **Waffo Pancake** (Waffo.com Limited). Payment card information is processed under Level 1 PCI-DSS compliance and is never stored on our servers.
- **5.2 Recurring Billing Authorization:** By purchasing a monthly or annual subscription, you explicitly authorize recurring charges to your designated payment method at each renewal interval until cancelled in accordance with Section 6.
- **5.3 One-Time Purchases:** Starter credit packs are single, non-recurring transactions charged at checkout.
- **5.4 Taxes:** Stated prices are exclusive of applicable value-added tax (VAT), sales tax, or GST, which will be calculated and collected at checkout where required by law.

---

### 6. Cancellation Policy
- **6.1 Easy Online Cancellation:** You may cancel your recurring subscription at any time with a single click via your **Account Settings → Manage Subscription**, or by emailing `cancel@qwenimage-editor.com` / `support@qwenimage-editor.com`.
- **6.2 Cancellation Effect:** Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current paid billing period. You retain full access to your plan benefits and remaining subscription quota until that period ends. No subsequent renewal charges will be made.

---

### 7. Refund Policy & Guarantees
- **7.1 7-Day Subscription Guarantee:** New subscribers may request a full refund within 7 calendar days of initial purchase, provided that credit consumption has not exceeded 20% of the allocated monthly plan quota.
- **7.2 One-Time Credit Packs:** One-time credit packages are eligible for a 100% refund within 7 days of purchase if zero credits have been used. Consumed credits are non-refundable.
- **7.3 Duplicate Charges & Downtime:** Verified billing discrepancies, duplicate charges, or prolonged unannounced system outages exceeding 72 consecutive hours will be refunded in full or compensated upon request.
- **7.4 Credit Rollover & Lifetime:**
  - Credits included with recurring subscriptions reset at each monthly billing cycle.
  - Separately purchased credit packs **never expire** and remain valid indefinitely regardless of subscription status.
  - Usage automatically consumes subscription credits first before deducting from non-expiring credit packs.
- **7.5 How to Request a Refund:** Email `refunds@qwenimage-editor.com` or `billing@qwenimage-editor.com` with your account email and transaction ID. We review requests within 2 business days and refunds are returned to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

---

### 8. Billing Disputes
If you notice an unexpected or erroneous charge, please contact us at `billing@qwenimage-editor.com` before contacting your bank or filing a payment dispute. We respond to billing inquiries within 48 hours and work to resolve genuine issues quickly and fairly.

---

### 9. Intellectual Property & AI Outputs
- **9.1 Output Ownership:** Subject to applicable law and foundation model licenses, you own the AI image outputs generated from your input prompts and images. You may use outputs for lawful personal and commercial purposes.
- **9.2 Input License & Privacy:** You grant us only the limited, temporary license necessary to process and generate your requested images. **We do NOT use your private images or uploaded content to train foundational AI models.**
- **9.3 Quality & Accuracy:** Generative AI outputs are probabilistic. Users should verify visual outputs before commercial deployment.

---

### 10. Acceptable Use Policy
You agree not to use the Service to generate, transmit, or promote:
- Illegal, sexually explicit (NSFW), hateful, or defamatory material.
- Non-consensual deepfakes designed to impersonate real persons or deceive viewers regarding origin or authenticity.
- Content depicting or exploiting minors (CSAM).
- Malicious software, phishing mechanisms, or intellectual property infringements.
- Systematic scraping or distilling model outputs to develop competing machine learning models.

---

### 11. Data Protection & Security
Your use of the Service is governed by our [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy). Payment data is handled solely by Waffo Pancake under PCI-DSS standards. Inactive account data is permanently deleted 90 days after account closure requests.

---

### 12. Limitation of Liability
The Service is provided "as is" and "as available". To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Qwen Image Editor and its operators shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Our aggregate liability is strictly limited to the total amount paid by you to the Service in the 12 months preceding the claim.

---

### 13. Contact Information
- **Support & Inquiries:** `support@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Billing & Subscriptions:** `billing@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Refund Requests:** `refunds@qwenimage-editor.com`
- **Merchant of Record:** Waffo Pancake (Waffo.com Limited)
- **Website:** [https://qwenimage-editor.com](https://qwenimage-editor.com)
